initial_tree.abstention_policy: Only root-invariant labels qualify as structurally resolved; ranked labels remain exploratory
initial_tree.score_interpretation: composite pair log score; not an independent likelihood or calibrated posterior
initial_tree.distance_source: Frozen forest mean meioses, not measured IBD or kinship

optimized_tree.score_interpretation: Composite degree log score for edge lengths, full-label composite score for roots; neither is an independent likelihood or calibrated posterior
optimized_tree.uncertainty_scope: Root ambiguity is conditional on selected edge lengths and does not cover other edge-length assignments or other topologies
